extraction.title: Add HTML sanitizer for translated message resources
extraction.head: feature-html-sanitizer-implementation

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as adding OWASP HTML Sanitizer policies (POLICY_NO_HTML, POLICY_SOME_HTML) to VerifyMessageProperties.java, with new test resources, mass translation HTML fixes, and two new Maven dependencies. Confidence score of 2/5, citing possible infinite loops, hardcoded assumptions, and an Italian string in a Lithuanian file.
Style: the file is missing a final newline, which violates the .editorconfig requirement.
Logic: the totpStep1 line contains Italian text in a Lithuanian file. It should be replaced with the Lithuanian translation with the FreeOTP and Google Authenticator links.
Style: missing final newline, per the .editorconfig rules.
Style: missing newline at end of file, violating the insert_final_newline = true rule in .editorconfig.
Style: the POLICY_SOME_HTML instance field should be declared private static final for thread safety and memory efficiency. Suggested change adds those modifiers.
Syntax: the method name santizeAnchors is misspelled and should be sanitizeAnchors. Suggested change renames it.

Logic: critical localization error. Italian text replaced the Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 translation, breaking the instructions for Lithuanian users and removing the authenticator app download links. Suggested change restores the Lithuanian text.
Style: the explicit compile scope on the commons-text dependency (1.13.0) is redundant because compile is the default. Suggested change removes it.
